old122_difference.old: Hazard ID side reservation with a new restricted graph search; held while connected regardless of cost disadvantage.
old122_difference.current: Only already computed, currently valid candidates within0.05m of the original minimum score. One-step previous route transported by existing tracker motion; no ID reservation, extra search or forced stale path.
old122_difference.old_result_context: 122 reduced flips but advanced contact by4 actions; different older champion/case, implementation warning rather than paired performance evidence.

frozen_rule.score: Existing base-cost gap + speed*abs(next_steer-previous_steer)/3, in nominal metres; original scores unchanged.
frozen_rule.fallback: Unavailable/untransportable prior crossing, missing same-side current candidate, or score excess>0.05 returns original ranking.
frozen_rule.candidate_validity_scope: Connected in the existing current-pixel graph; not a swept-body collision-free guarantee.

prefix.flip_metric: Same physical obstacle, route transverse crossing at current obstacle-forward plane; omit undefined crossings. Candidate has no crossing at122, so no continuous side-hold claim.

gate_registered_before_runs.stop: Both normal endpoints unless a technical fault; max2000 actions each. No parameter changes after prefix or first endpoint.
gate_registered_before_runs.time_gate: Both complete, no lost completion; median lap delta<0 and mean lap ratio<1 versus current champion.
gate_registered_before_runs.damage_gate_for_future_candidate: Total damage<=baseline0.2 and clean DEV damage=0. Flip count alone never qualifies.

interpretation: One actual tie selection removed the late route reversals and large local actuator lag, but first contact occurred2 actions earlier. Full contactDEV lap improved1.34s with damage0.2->0.6; cleanDEV is bit-identical. Flip/lag reduction does not establish avoidance or acceptable damage. Time gate passes, predeclared damage gate fails; reject without retuning or champion adoption.

cost.timing_scope: Prefix and two full candidate runs; preparation, saved-score analysis and documentation excluded. Actor and evaluator CPU separate.
